workflow_name: Android App Performance Root Diagnostic - Flow 4: Cross-Session Comparison (DUT1 vs DUT2)
description: Compares two DUT sessions to detect regressions or improvements between app versions. Normalized formula: delta = (DUT2 - REF2) - (DUT1 - REF1). Positive delta = DUT2 regressed. Covers ALL metric categories from Flow 1, 2, 3.
precondition: Requires at least 2 DUT sessions (DUT1+REF1, DUT2+REF2).

node_00_cross_session_root.description: Cross-Session Regression & Improvement Analysis — mirrors Flow1/2/3 checks across sessions

node_01_uptime_regression.description: Check if uptime conditions differ significantly between DUT1 and DUT2 test sessions

node_01a_uptime_mismatch_result.problem: Uptime conditions differ between sessions: DUT1={DUT1.uptime_minutes} min vs DUT2={DUT2.uptime_minutes} min — system cache state may not be equivalent, affecting comparison reliability
node_01a_uptime_mismatch_result.suggestion: Ensure both test sessions start with similar device uptime (within 5 minutes) for valid cross-session comparison

node_02_touch_duration_regression.description: Check if touch duration regressed between DUT versions (normalized vs REF)

node_02a_touch_duration_result.problem: Touch duration regressed in DUT2 vs DUT1: normalized delta = {delta} ms — system responsiveness may have degraded in new version
node_02a_touch_duration_result.suggestion: Suggest System team check input handling changes between DUT1 and DUT2 builds

node_03_state_mismatch_check.description: Check if same app has different launch states (Cold/Warm) across DUT1 and DUT2 — makes comparison invalid

node_03a_state_mismatch_result.problem: Launch state mismatch across sessions: DUT1={DUT1.State[0]} vs DUT2={DUT2.State[0]} — cross-session comparison is unreliable for this app
node_03a_state_mismatch_result.suggestion: Re-run test sessions ensuring same launch state (both Cold or both Warm) before comparing

node_04_exec_time_regression.description: Check App Execution Time regression between DUT versions (primary metric)
node_04_exec_time_regression.operator: delta = (DUT2['App Execution Time'] - REF2['App Execution Time']) - (DUT1['App Execution Time'] - REF1['App Execution Time']); delta > threshold

node_04a_exec_regression_result.problem: App Execution Time regressed in DUT2 vs DUT1: normalized delta = {delta} ms (DUT2-REF2={DUT2.exec - REF2.exec} ms vs DUT1-REF1={DUT1.exec - REF1.exec} ms)
node_04a_exec_regression_result.suggestion: Suggest App team compare DUT1 and DUT2 builds. Investigate sub-metrics (Bind Application, Running, Block I/O) for root cause

node_04c_exec_improvement_result.problem: IMPROVEMENT: App Execution Time improved in DUT2 vs DUT1: normalized delta = {delta} ms
node_04c_exec_improvement_result.suggestion: Verify improvement is consistent across all cycles and not caused by state/environment difference

node_04b_query_exec_regression.query: Check commit history between DUT1 and DUT2 build versions for this app

node_05_crash_regression.description: Check if crashes (ANR/FATAL) appeared or increased in DUT2 vs DUT1

node_05a_crash_regression_result.problem: New crashes in DUT2: DUT2={DUT2.crashes} crashes vs DUT1={DUT1.crashes} crashes (ANR/FATAL) — regression introduced in new version
node_05a_crash_regression_result.suggestion: URGENT: Suggest App team investigate crash introduced in DUT2 build before release

node_05b_query_crash_history.query: Search crash history for this app across recent builds

node_G2_performance_group.description: Cross-session: Core performance state checks (Flow 2 scope)

node_06_running_regression.description: Check if Running time regressed between DUT versions (normalized vs REF)

node_06a_running_regression_result.problem: Running time regressed in DUT2 vs DUT1: normalized delta = {delta} ms — app executing more CPU work in new version
node_06a_running_regression_result.suggestion: Suggest App team check what additional code paths were added in DUT2 that increase CPU execution time

node_06b_running_sub_group.description: Drill down into Running regression root causes

node_06c_query_running_version.query: Check new app version changes or fixes that may affect running time

node_07_sleeping_regression.description: Check if Sleeping time regressed between DUT versions (normalized vs REF)

node_07a_sleeping_regression_result.problem: Sleeping time regressed in DUT2 vs DUT1: normalized delta = {delta} ms — app spending more time waiting (IPC, binder, locks) in new version
node_07a_sleeping_regression_result.suggestion: Suggest App team check for new blocking calls or IPC overhead added in DUT2

node_07b_sleeping_sub_group.description: Drill down into Sleeping regression — mirrors Flow 2 node_07_sleeping_sub_issues

node_07c_query_sleeping_version.query: Check app fix history related to sleeping/blocking regression

node_08_runnable_regression.description: Check if Runnable time regressed between DUT versions — indicates CPU contention increased

node_08a_runnable_regression_result.problem: Runnable time regressed in DUT2 vs DUT1: normalized delta = {delta} ms — more CPU contention in new version
node_08a_runnable_regression_result.suggestion: Suggest System team check if new background processes were introduced in DUT2 build

node_09_compiler_regression.description: Check if compiler type degraded between DUT versions — mirrors Flow 2 node_10_compiler_check

node_09a_compiler_regression_result.problem: Compiler type degraded between versions: DUT1={DUT1.compiler_type} → DUT2={DUT2.compiler_type} — Cold launch will be significantly slower in DUT2 build
node_09a_compiler_regression_result.suggestion: Suggest App TG restore speed-profile compilation in DUT2 build

node_09b_query_compiler_change.query: Check if compiler config was changed between build versions

node_10_frequency_regression.description: Check if CPU frequency profile regressed between DUT versions — mirrors Flow 2 node_12_frequency_check
node_10_frequency_regression.operator: ## Cross-session frequency analysis: For each phase (bindApplication, activityStart, activityResume, Choreographer), compare the highest-frequency bucket percentage. Compute: delta_freq = (DUT2_high_freq_pct - REF2_high_freq_pct) - (DUT1_high_freq_pct - REF1_high_freq_pct). If delta_freq < -threshold (DUT2 runs at high freq less than DUT1 did), flag as regression.

node_10a_frequency_regression_result.problem: CPU frequency profile regressed in DUT2 vs DUT1: app running at lower CPU frequency in new build (high-freq usage delta < -{threshold}% in one or more phases)
node_10a_frequency_regression_result.suggestion: Suggest System team check DVFS/scheduler config changes between DUT1 and DUT2 builds

node_10b_query_frequency.query: Check frequency config or scheduler changes between builds

node_11_binder_regression.description: Check if binder transaction count/duration regressed between DUT versions — mirrors Flow 2 node_19_binder_check

node_11a_binder_regression_result.problem: Binder transaction count regressed in DUT2 vs DUT1: normalized delta = {delta_count} binder calls — new IPC overhead introduced in DUT2
node_11a_binder_regression_result.suggestion: Suggest App team check for new binder calls or IPC patterns added in DUT2 build

node_12_priority_regression.description: Check if thread scheduling priority regressed between DUT versions — mirrors Flow 2 node_08_priority_check
node_12_priority_regression.operator: ## Cross-session priority analysis: For each phase (bindApplication, activityStart, activityResume, Choreographer), compare high-priority (low numeric value) percentage. Compute: delta_prio = (DUT2_high_prio_pct - REF2_high_prio_pct) - (DUT1_high_prio_pct - REF1_high_prio_pct). If delta_prio < -threshold, DUT2 has worse priority scheduling than DUT1.

node_12a_priority_regression_result.problem: Thread scheduling priority regressed in DUT2 vs DUT1: main thread deprioritized more in new build (high-priority usage delta < -{threshold}% in one or more phases)
node_12a_priority_regression_result.suggestion: Suggest System team check scheduling priority config changes between DUT1 and DUT2 builds

node_12b_query_priority.query: Check scheduling or priority config changes between builds

node_13_beks_regression.description: Check if BEKS protection setting changed between DUT1 and DUT2 — mirrors Flow 2 node_35_beks_check

node_13a_beks_regression_result.problem: BEKS protection config changed between sessions: DUT1={DUT1.beks} vs DUT2={DUT2.beks} — may affect launch state (Cold vs Warm) and performance
node_13a_beks_regression_result.suggestion: Suggest System team verify BEKS config is consistent between DUT1 and DUT2 builds

node_14_bind_app_regression.description: Check Bind Application regression between DUT versions (Cold launch only) — key signal for app init overhead increase
node_14_bind_app_regression.operator: delta = (DUT2['Bind Application'] - REF2['Bind Application']) - (DUT1['Bind Application'] - REF1['Bind Application']); delta > threshold

node_14a_bind_regression_result.problem: Bind Application regressed in DUT2 vs DUT1: normalized delta = {delta} ms — new class loading or Application.onCreate() overhead in new version
node_14a_bind_regression_result.suggestion: Suggest App team check what changed in Application.onCreate() or static initializers between DUT1 and DUT2 builds

node_15_start_kill_regression.description: Check if start/kill patterns changed between DUT versions — mirrors Flow 2 node_36_start_kill_check

node_15a_start_kill_regression_result.problem: Start/Kill pattern changed between sessions: DUT1 start={DUT1.start_reason.length}/kill={DUT1.kill_reason.length} vs DUT2 start={DUT2.start_reason.length}/kill={DUT2.kill_reason.length} — different launch state context between test sessions
node_15a_start_kill_regression_result.suggestion: Suggest App team and SWPL investigate start/kill count change between DUT1 and DUT2 builds

node_15b_query_start_kill.query: Check start/kill history for this app between build versions

node_16_load_apk_regression.description: Check if LoadApkAssets time regressed between DUT versions — mirrors Flow 3 node_01_load_apk_asset_check

node_16a_load_apk_regression_result.problem: LoadApkAssets time regressed in DUT2 vs DUT1: normalized delta = {delta} ms — new or larger assets being loaded in new version
node_16a_load_apk_regression_result.suggestion: Suggest App team check for new assets or APK size increase in DUT2 build

node_16b_apk_size_check.description: Check if APK size increased in DUT2 — mirrors Flow 3 node_08_apk_size_check

node_16c_apk_size_result.problem: APK size increased in DUT2 vs DUT1: DUT1={DUT1.apk_size} vs DUT2={DUT2.apk_size} — larger APK contributes to slower LoadApkAssets
node_16c_apk_size_result.suggestion: Suggest App team optimize APK size in DUT2 build

node_16d_query_apk_size.query: Check APK size history by app and version, compare DUT1 vs DUT2

node_17_block_io_regression.description: Check if Uninterruptible Sleep (I/O wait) regressed between DUT versions — mirrors Flow 3 node_02_block_io_check
node_17_block_io_regression.operator: delta = (DUT2['Uninterruptible Sleep'] - REF2['Uninterruptible Sleep']) - (DUT1['Uninterruptible Sleep'] - REF1['Uninterruptible Sleep']); delta > threshold

node_17a_block_io_sub_group.description: Drill down into Block I/O regression root causes — mirrors Flow 3 node_06_block_io_sub

node_17d_block_io_result.problem: Uninterruptible Sleep (Block I/O wait) regressed in DUT2 vs DUT1: normalized delta = {delta} ms — more disk I/O blocking in new version
node_17d_block_io_result.suggestion: Investigate memory pressure and pageboost data to identify root cause (see sub-checks)

node_17b_memory_regression.description: Check if memory conditions degraded between DUT versions, causing more I/O — mirrors Flow 3 node_07_memory_check_detailed
node_17b_memory_regression.operator: DUT1.MemFree_MB - DUT2.MemFree_MB > threshold OR DUT1.MemAvailable_MB - DUT2.MemAvailable_MB > threshold

node_17b1_memory_regression_result.problem: Available memory decreased in DUT2 vs DUT1: MemFree -{DUT1.MemFree_MB - DUT2.MemFree_MB} MB, MemAvailable -{DUT1.MemAvailable_MB - DUT2.MemAvailable_MB} MB — memory pressure is likely causing more Block I/O
node_17b1_memory_regression_result.suggestion: Suggest Kernel Memory team investigate memory regression between DUT1 and DUT2 builds

node_17b2_query_memory_regression.query: Check memory trend across recent builds for this model

node_17c_pageboost_regression.description: Check if Pageboost prefetch amount decreased between DUT versions — mirrors Flow 3 node_11_pageboost_check

node_17c1_pageboost_regression_result.problem: Pageboost prefetch amount decreased in DUT2 vs DUT1: {DUT1.Pageboostd_MB - DUT2.Pageboostd_MB} MB less prefetched — may cause more Block I/O at launch
node_17c1_pageboost_regression_result.suggestion: Suggest Kernel Memory team check pageboost operation changes between DUT1 and DUT2 builds

node_18_process_abnormal_group.description: Cross-session: Process & CPU anomaly checks — mirrors Flow 3 node_03_process_abnormal

node_19_parallel_process_regression.description: Check if new abnormal parallel processes appeared in DUT2 that were absent in DUT1 — mirrors Flow 3 node_23_parallel_process_check

logic.condition: DUT2.start_process_abnormal has process_names NOT present in DUT1.start_process_abnormal

node_19a_parallel_process_result.problem: New abnormal parallel processes detected in DUT2 that were not in DUT1: {new_process_names} — new background activity at launch time in new version
node_19a_parallel_process_result.suggestion: Suggest App team and SWPL investigate new processes introduced in DUT2 build

node_19b_query_parallel.query: Search history for similar parallel process issue on this model

node_20_top_cpu_regression.description: Check if top CPU-consuming processes worsened between DUT versions — mirrors Flow 3 node_24_top_cpu_check

logic.operator: For each cycle in DUT2, check if any process.diff > threshold AND that process.diff is > corresponding DUT1 cycle's same process.diff by more than 100ms. Collect (cycle, process_name, dut2_diff, dut1_diff) for flagged entries.

node_20a_top_cpu_regression_result.problem: CPU consumption worsened in DUT2 vs DUT1: Cycle {cycle}, process {process_name} used {dut2_diff} ms in DUT2 vs {dut1_diff} ms in DUT1 — process became more CPU-intensive in new version
node_20a_top_cpu_regression_result.suggestion: Suggest SWPL check with owner of {process_name} process about increased CPU usage in DUT2 build

node_20b_query_top_cpu.query: Check if other models or apps have similar CPU regression for this process

node_21_kill_reason_regression.description: Check if new kill reasons appeared in DUT2 that were absent in DUT1 — mirrors Flow 2 node_36_start_kill_check kill aspect

node_21a_kill_regression_result.problem: Kill reasons appeared in DUT2 that were not in DUT1: {DUT2.kill_reason} — app being killed more aggressively in new version (memory pressure or new background policy)
node_21a_kill_regression_result.suggestion: Suggest App team and SWPL investigate new kill events introduced in DUT2 build

node_22_pss_regression.description: Check if App PSS memory footprint increased in DUT2 — mirrors Flow 3 node_25_pss_check

node_22a_pss_regression_result.problem: App PSS memory increased in DUT2: {DUT2.App_PSS_MB - DUT1.App_PSS_MB} MB more than DUT1 (DUT1={DUT1.App_PSS_MB} MB → DUT2={DUT2.App_PSS_MB} MB)
node_22a_pss_regression_result.suggestion: Suggest App owner debug PSS increase — possible memory leak or new resource allocation in DUT2 build

node_22b_query_pss_regression.query: Search PSS memory trend for this app across builds
